source: ERICA Study (Estudo de Riscos Cardiovasculares em Adolescentes)
citation: Jardim TV, Rosner B, Bloch KV, et al. Blood pressure reference values for Brazilian adolescents: data from the Study of Cardiovascular Risk in Adolescents (ERICA Study). J Pediatr (Rio J). 2020;96(2):168-176.
description: Polynomial regression coefficients for SBP and DBP in female Brazilian adolescents aged 12-17 years, from supplementary Table S1
methodology: Polynomial regression with restricted cubic splines. BP = Intercept + b1*(Age-15) + b2*(Age-15)^2 + b3*(Age-15)^3 + b4*(Age-15)^4 + b5*Zht + b6*Zht^2 + b7*Zht^3 + b8*Zht^4
